f3_program: observe(at("amalia.book.pages_read.count", "reference"), 4, "count", source("4 pages of her book"))
observe(at("amalia.book.reading_duration", "reference"), 2, "minute", source("2 minutes"))
rate_relation(at("amalia.book.pages_read.count", "reference"), "amalia.book.reading_rate", at("amalia.book.reading_duration", "reference"), source("Amalia can read 4 pages of her book in 2 minutes"))
observe(at("amalia.book.pages_read.count", "target"), 18, "count", source("read 18 pages of her book"))

rate_relation(at("amalia.book.pages_read.count", "target"), "amalia.book.reading_rate", at("amalia.book.reading_duration", "target"), source("How many minutes will it take her to read 18 pages of her book?"))
query("value", at("amalia.book.reading_duration", "target"))
assumptions: The 18-page target uses Amalia's stated reading rate.

f3_program: add("jeanine_purchase", "jeanine", at("jeanine.pencils.count", "current"), 18, source("Jeanine bought 18 pencils"))
add("clare_purchase", "clare", at("clare.pencils.count", "current"), fraction(event_field("jeanine_purchase", "quantity"), 1, 2), source("Clare bought half as many pencils"))

transfer("jeanine_to_abby", "jeanine", at("jeanine.pencils.count", "current"), at("abby.pencils.count", "current"), fraction(at("jeanine.pencils.count", "current"), 1, 3), source("Jeanine gave one third of his pencils to Abby"))
query("difference", at("clare.pencils.count", "current"), at("jeanine.pencils.count", "current"))
assumptions: The pronoun "his" refers to Jeanine, the named giver.

f3_program: collection("cole.backyard.fence.sides", "fence_side", "cole.backyard", source("fence his backyard on three sides"))
observe(at("cole.backyard.fence.sides.count", "planned"), 3, "count", source("three sides"))
observe(at("cole.backyard.left_side.length", "current"), 9, "foot", source("9 feet along the sides"))
observe(at("cole.backyard.right_side.length", "current"), 9, "foot", source("9 feet along the sides"))
observe(at("cole.backyard.back_side.length", "current"), 18, "foot", source("18 feet along the back"))
observe(at("fencing.cost_per_foot", "current"), 3, "dollar_per_foot", source("Fencing costs $3 per foot"))
rate_relation(at("cole.backyard.fence.left_side.cost", "planned"), at("fencing.cost_per_foot", "current"), at("cole.backyard.left_side.length", "current"), source("Fencing costs $3 per foot"))
rate_relation(at("cole.backyard.fence.right_side.cost", "planned"), at("fencing.cost_per_foot", "current"), at("cole.backyard.right_side.length", "current"), source("Fencing costs $3 per foot"))
rate_relation(at("cole.backyard.fence.back_side.cost", "planned"), at("fencing.cost_per_foot", "current"), at("cole.backyard.back_side.length", "current"), source("Fencing costs $3 per foot"))

fraction_of(at("cole.neighbor.behind.fence_payment", "planned"), at("cole.backyard.fence.back_side.cost", "planned"), 1, 2, source("The neighbor behind him agreed to pay for half of their shared side of his fence"))

fraction_of(at("cole.neighbor.left.fence_payment", "planned"), at("cole.backyard.fence.left_side.cost", "planned"), 1, 3, source("the neighbor on his left agreed to pay for a third of their shared side"))
query("value", at("cole.backyard.fence.payment", "planned"))
assumptions: The two 9-foot sides are the left and right sides, while the 18-foot back is shared with the neighbor behind Cole.
Each neighbor's stated fraction refers to that shared side's fencing cost.

f3_program: collection("lucille.mother.garden.weeds", "weed", "lucille.mother.garden", source("every weed she pulled in her mom's garden"))
observe(at("lucille.weeding.earnings_rate", "current"), 6, "cent_per_weed", source("six cents for every weed she pulled"))

rate_relation("lucille.weeding.earnings.cents", at("lucille.weeding.earnings_rate", "current"), "lucille.weeds_pulled.count", source("she would earn six cents for every weed she pulled in her mom's garden"))
observe(at("lucille.mother.garden.flower_bed.weeds.count", "initial"), 11, "count", source("eleven weeds in the flower bed"))
observe(at("lucille.mother.garden.vegetable_patch.weeds.count", "initial"), 14, "count", source("fourteen in the vegetable patch"))
observe(at("lucille.mother.garden.fruit_tree_grass.weeds.count", "initial"), 32, "count", source("thirty-two in the grass around the fruit trees"))

remove("weed_flower_bed", "lucille", at("lucille.mother.garden.flower_bed.weeds.count", "current"), at("lucille.mother.garden.flower_bed.weeds.count", "initial"), source("Lucille weeded the flower bed, the vegetable patch, and half the grass"))

remove("weed_vegetable_patch", "lucille", at("lucille.mother.garden.vegetable_patch.weeds.count", "current"), at("lucille.mother.garden.vegetable_patch.weeds.count", "initial"), source("Lucille weeded the flower bed, the vegetable patch, and half the grass"))

remove("weed_fruit_tree_grass", "lucille", at("lucille.mother.garden.fruit_tree_grass.weeds.count", "current"), fraction(at("lucille.mother.garden.fruit_tree_grass.weeds.count", "initial"), 1, 2), source("Lucille weeded the flower bed, the vegetable patch, and half the grass"))
produce("weeding_earnings", "lucille", at("lucille.earnings.cents", "current"), "lucille.weeding.earnings.cents", source("she would earn six cents for every weed she pulled in her mom's garden"))
remove("soda_purchase", "lucille", at("lucille.earnings.cents", "current"), 99, source("She bought a soda for 99 cents on her break with some of her earnings"))
query("value", at("lucille.earnings.cents", "current"))
assumptions: Weeding the flower bed and vegetable patch means pulling all weeds in those locations; "half the grass" means half of the weeds in the grass.

f3_program: collection("dinner.pizzas", "pizza", "pizzeria", source("share 2 pizzas"))
observe(at("dinner.pizzas.count", "initial"), 2, "count", source("2 pizzas"))
consume("bob_eats_pizza", "bob", at("dinner.pizzas.count", "current"), fraction("dinner.pizza.unit", 1, 2), source("Bob ate half of a pizza on his own"))
consume("tom_eats_pizza", "tom", at("dinner.pizzas.count", "current"), fraction("dinner.pizza.unit", 1, 3), source("Tom ate one-third of a pizza"))
consume("sally_eats_pizza", "sally", at("dinner.pizzas.count", "current"), fraction("dinner.pizza.unit", 1, 6), source("only ate one-sixth of a pizza"))
consume("jerry_eats_pizza", "jerry", at("dinner.pizzas.count", "current"), fraction("dinner.pizza.unit", 1, 4), source("Jerry ate a quarter of a pizza"))
collection("dinner.pizza_slices", "slice", "dinner.pizzas", source("each pizza is cut into 12 slices"))
observe(at("dinner.pizza_slices.per_pizza.count", "current"), 12, "count", source("12 slices"))
rate_relation(at("dinner.pizza_slices.count", "current"), at("dinner.pizza_slices.per_pizza.count", "current"), at("dinner.pizzas.count", "current"), source("each pizza is cut into 12 slices"))
query("remaining_count", "dinner.pizza_slices", "current")
